travel.text: Munnar → Eravikulam → Marayoor → Chinnar and back by cab
travel.time: about 4 h of driving, in hops

morning.text: Eravikulam National Park, first slot booked online (₹250 each): forest bus up, Nilgiri tahr walk
Cab east to Marayoor, about 1.5 h (shared cab for three, Est. ₹3,500 for the day)

afternoon.text: Lunch in Marayoor; fill water bottles
Muniyara dolmens, a short stop at the megalithic burial chambers

Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary: guided walk to Thoovanam Falls, about 4 km. Guided groups are advised to start by 14:00 so they finish before the gates close; sightings (grizzled giant squirrel, deer) are not guaranteed

evening.text: Drive back to Munnar, about 1.5 h
Dinner in town, early night

optional.text: Phone the Munnar Forest Information Centre or DTPC Idukki (+91 85476 03199 is listed) a few days ahead: sources disagree on the Chinnar fee, the guide rules and booking

Kolukkumalai sunrise jeep (Est. ₹4,000) instead of the Eravikulam slot. 23 Dec is a weekday; 27 Dec last year was the heaviest day, with 3,060 visitors in 510 jeeps

days.food: Banana-leaf lunch in Marayoor; carry water for the Chinnar walk

travel.text: Fort Kochi → Kumbalangi → Fort Kochi → Ernakulam Jn

Back in Fort Kochi, check out; bags stay at the stay

afternoon.text: Lunch
Mattancherry Palace and Jew Town's spice and antique lanes. The palace is thought to close on Fridays, so Saturday is fine (verify). The Paradesi Synagogue is closed on Saturdays, so we skip it

Tea-estate stop and a tea-factory tasting on the way back

Mattupetty Dam and Echo Point
Kundala and Top Station viewpoint for the late light

travel.text: Local only, by auto or the car

morning.text: Guided nature walk or border hike in Periyar Tiger Reserve (Forest Department; tickets and slots sell out in Christmas week, so book online ahead)
Breakfast back in Kumily

afternoon.text: Lunch and rest
Boat cruise on Periyar Lake, best slot you can get (elephants and bison often come to the shore)
Tea or coffee at a plantation café

evening.text: Christmas dinner out; most places are open, and a few raise prices

optional.text: Bamboo rafting instead of the walk, if slots are free (about ₹1,500 each, Est.)

Leave Alleppey for Varkala; a coffee stop around Kollam

Cliff walk, then Papanasam Beach (swim only between the lifeguard flags)

travel.text: Varkala → Thiruvananthapuram → Kovalam by car

morning.text: Leave Varkala early so the temple stop is possible
Padmanabhaswamy Temple, if you want the interior: strict dress code and morning darshan hours, and entry rules apply (check before going). Otherwise see the Kuthiramalika area from outside

afternoon.text: Chalai market and lunch in the old town
Napier Museum and zoo complex: a Monday closure is likely, so check; if closed, go to Veli Tourist Village or Shanghumugham Beach instead
Drive to Kovalam, check in

evening.text: Sunset at Lighthouse Beach; climb the Vizhinjam lighthouse if open
Dinner on the beach road

optional.text: Vizhinjam rock-cut cave temple, a short stop on the way into Kovalam

days.food: Seafood on the beach road; try puttu with kadala curry for breakfast

days.title: Drive back to Kochi for the 16:00 train

travel.text: Kovalam → Ernakulam by car on NH66

morning.text: Short sunrise walk on the beach
Breakfast, check out
Leave Kovalam. Hard rule: not later than 09:00, or the train is at risk

afternoon.text: Lunch near Kollam or Alleppey, 45 min at most
Arrive Ernakulam; bags are in the car, so go straight to the station if needed
Be at the station, which still leaves about 1.5 h before the 16:00 train
Return train from Kochi

optional.text: If you arrive at 13:00 or earlier, a quick Fort Kochi walk and fishing-net stop is possible; only if there are 2.5 h or more in hand
